lockReason: Safe mode is on: automatic core/plugin/theme updates cannot be switched off. This keeps the site up to date; it does not give automatic rollback after a broken update — background updates still have no file rollback.

autoCore.label: Automatic WordPress core updates
autoCore.desc: Install new WordPress releases automatically, including major versions

autoPlugins.label: Automatic plugin updates
autoPlugins.desc: Every plugin from the WordPress directory stays on its latest version

autoThemes.label: Automatic theme updates
